result.rationale: The diff shows `update` in Admin::EmbeddingController does nothing but re-render the serializer: `def update ... render_serialized(@embedding, EmbeddingSerializer, ...)` with no params applied. `fetch_embedding` just rebuilds an OpenStruct from EmbeddableHost.all. The frontend `saveChanges()` calls `this.get('embedding').update({})`, so the UI's save button has no backend effect. Verified directly from the diff.

adjudication.rationale: In `app/controllers/admin/embedding_controller.rb`, `def update` only re-renders the serialized `@embedding` and never reads params or persists anything. On the client, `admin/controllers/admin-embedding.js.es6` defines a `saveChanges` action that calls `this.get('embedding').update({})`, which would hit that no-op endpoint if invoked. However, in the provided `app/assets/javascripts/admin/templates/embedding.hbs` there is no save button or usage of `saveChanges`, so the claim that the UI save button “silently does nothing” isn’t directly verifiable from this diff alone.
